choice.basis: The May bar is the shortest on the chart, with its top positioned just above the x-axis baseline and well below the lowest labeled grid line of 10,000 m3. In contrast, the other displayed months (Apr, Jan, Jun, Feb, Mar) all have release volumes between approximately 17,500 m3 and 40,000 m3. This makes May a critical low-release anomaly relative to the other months in the reporting cycle.
choice.option_label: Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review
